description: Offensive shield melee - Strength converts into block rating, blocks feed Reprisal, and Centurion Strike changes with the weapon in hand.
_source_note: Rebuilt from reference/coa_sidekick/talents/guardian.json. CoA: 'retail Protection Warrior played in an offensive/PvP posture, a DPS-Prot hybrid'. Two real stat conversions carry it - Shield Training turning Strength into block value and Experienced Combatant turning Strength into attack power - which is why its stat priority puts Strength and block rating together. Block is an offensive stat for this spec alone.

nodes.name: Might
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your attack power by 5%. (up to 2 ranks)'

nodes.name: Built Different
nodes.description: Increases your Strength and Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Strength and Stamina by 4%.'

nodes.name: Sword Training
nodes.description: While a sword is equipped, increases your haste by 3 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While a sword is equipped, your melee haste is increased by 10%. (up to 3 ranks)'. Weapon-type conditions have no hook, so it applies always - noted rather than renamed, because the whole weapon-training row is part of this spec's identity.

nodes.name: Legionnaire
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical damage of Centurion Strike and Reprisal by 10%. (up to 2 ranks)'

nodes.name: Shield Training
nodes.description: Grants block value equal to 3% of your Strength per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 20 Passive. Increases your block rating by 10% of your Strength.' A REAL stat conversion through the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps, and the spec's signature: Strength is its damage stat and its mitigation stat at once.

nodes.name: Tactical Combat
nodes.description: Increases the damage your blocks absorb by 4% and your block chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your block value by 8% and chance to block by 2%. (up to 2 ranks)'

nodes.name: Waste No Movement
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your abilities by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of Broad Sweep, Spear Throw, and Centurion Strike by -5.'

nodes.name: Upper Hand
nodes.description: Your swings sometimes land twice.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your melee auto attacks now have a 20% chance to strike 2 additional times.'

nodes.name: Crashing Force
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Reprisal by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of your Centurion Strike and Reprisal by 15%. (up to 2 ranks)'

nodes.name: Myrmidon
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ram by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Ram and Broad Sweep by 25%.'

nodes.name: Double Duty
nodes.description: Grants 2 hit rating per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your hit chance by 5% and expertise by 4.' No expertise key exists.

nodes.name: Retiarius
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 8 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your maximum Energy by 25.'

nodes.name: Experienced Combatant
nodes.description: Grants attack power equal to 5% of your Strength per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 30 Passive. Increases your attack power by 20% of your Strength.' The second real conversion in this tree.

nodes.name: Deadly Blow
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Centurion Strike and Broad Sweep now bleed an additional 15% of the damage dealt over 3 seconds.'

nodes.name: Champion
nodes.description: Centurion Strike extends Raise Shield by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Centurion Strike now extends the duration of Raise Shield on you by 3 sec.'

nodes.name: Bulwark Rush
nodes.description: Charging in puts your shield where it needs to be.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Battle Rush increases your block rating by 25% of Strength for 6 seconds.'

nodes.name: Shield Combat
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 40 Passive. Casting Ram and Pulverize now increases your attack power based on your block rating for 6 seconds.' Block-rating-into-AP is not a conversion the engine offers in that direction.

nodes.name: Clinch Brawler
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Centurion Strike is now guaranteed to critically strike against enemies affected by Net Throw.' A guaranteed crit against a debuffed target has no hook.

nodes.name: Momentum
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Melee damage dealt now reduces the cooldown of your Chivalry by -2 sec.'

nodes.name: Favor
nodes.description: Crits and kills stack in your favour.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 50 Passive. Critical strikes and killing blows now grant you Favor for 1 minute, stacking 20 times.'

nodes.name: One-Handed Mastery
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your damage dealt by 10% while a one-handed weapon is equipped.'

nodes.name: Calculated Strike
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Reprisal, Broad Sweep, and Spear Throw now deal an additional 2% Weapon Damage for each Energy point you have upon [casting].' Scaling off current Energy has no hook.

nodes.name: Heroism
nodes.description: The crowd has already decided how this ends.
nodes._source: Capstone, a real CoA tier-6 Gladiator node: 'Whenever you reach 3 stacks of Glory or 20 stacks of Favor, your next 2 Pulverizes or Broad Sweeps within 10 seconds are [free].' CoA rates the spec 'Weak sustained single-target DPS ... high throughput ceiling', so the payoff is a burst window.
